purpose: Offline replay computational latency only; excludes acquisition, Bluetooth, RealSense driver and live synchronization.
window_policy: 2 s windows with 1 s step from canonically continuous CAR + 1-40 Hz fourth-order Butterworth IIR preprocessing; ICA disabled
preprocessing_timing_policy: continuous recording measured once; amortized value is not online per-window latency
face_attribution: sequential canonical VIDEO-mode frame times are summed for every overlapping 2-s window; this is descriptive replay attribution
